-- ============================================================
-- test-16-expressions_pos.fh  –  Ausdrücke PASS-Tests
--   (ACC-01..04,06, BOOL-01..05, OPR-01..04,06..09,12..13, PRI-07..13)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Expressions.Pos

import Test.Support exposing Point, Box, make_point, make_box, NotFound

-- ACC-01: Einfacher Feldzugriff
function get_x(p: Point) returns Integer
requires p.x >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return p.x
end get_x

-- ACC-02: Geschachtelter Zugriff
function get_box_x(b: Box) returns Integer
requires b.origin.x >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return b.origin.x
end get_box_x

-- ACC-04: Array-Indexierung
function first(arr: Array<Integer, 3>) returns Integer
requires arr[0] >= 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return arr[0]
end first

function last(arr: Array<Integer, 3>) returns Integer
is
    return arr[2]
end last

-- BOOL-01: true / false Literale
function bool_lits() returns Boolean
is
    let t: Boolean = true
    let f: Boolean = false
    return t
end bool_lits

-- BOOL-02: and
function both_pos(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Boolean
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
is
    return a > 0 and b > 0
end both_pos

-- BOOL-03: or
function either_pos(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Boolean
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
is
    return a > 0 or b > 0
end either_pos

-- BOOL-04: not
function is_zero(n: Integer) returns Boolean
requires n >= 0
is
    return not (n > 0)
end is_zero

-- OPR-01..04: Alle binären Arithmetik-Operatoren
function arithmetic(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0, b > 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    let s: Integer = a + b
    let d: Integer = a - b
    let p: Integer = a * b
    let q: Integer = a / b
    return s
end arithmetic

-- OPR-06: Unäres Minus
function negate(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
is
    return 0 - n
end negate

-- OPR-07..09: Vergleiche und Ungleichheit
function comparisons(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Boolean
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
is
    let eq:  Boolean = a = b
    let neq: Boolean = a != b
    let gt:  Boolean = a > b
    let gte: Boolean = a >= b
    let lt:  Boolean = a < b
    let lte: Boolean = a <= b
    return eq or neq or gt or gte or lt or lte
end comparisons

-- OPR-12: Operator-Präzedenz (* vor +)
function precedence(a: Integer, b: Integer, c: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0, b >= 0, c > 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return a + b * c
end precedence

-- OPR-13: Geklammerte Ausdrücke
function parenthesized(a: Integer, b: Integer, c: Integer) returns Integer
requires a >= 0, b >= 0, c > 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    return (a + b) * c
end parenthesized

-- PRI-07..10: Schlüsselwort-Primärausdrücke
function keyword_prim(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
ensures success, value >= 0
is
    let ok_flag:   Boolean = true
    let fail_flag: Boolean = false
    return ok n
end keyword_prim

-- PRI-11: Record-Konstruktion
function new_point(n: Integer) returns Point
requires n >= 0
ensures result.x = n, result.y = n
is
    return Point { x: n, y: n }
end new_point

-- PRI-12: Array-Literal
function array_lit(a: Integer, b: Integer, c: Integer) returns Array<Integer, 3>
requires a >= 0, b >= 0, c >= 0
ensures value[0] = a
is
    return [a, b, c]
end array_lit

-- PRI-13: Leeres Array-Literal
function empty_array() returns Array<Integer, 0>
is
    return []
end empty_array

end Test.Expressions.Pos
